docs: Starts from `initial` and, for each element `x` of `xs` from the first to the last, replaces
the accumulator `acc` by `step(acc, x)`, calling `step` at most once per element; the result
is the last accumulator, `initial` when `xs` is empty. In edition 0.2 and later it takes an
effectful and failing `step`, and stops at the first failure (`spec/14 §1`).
